gates.description: Every changed route or product behavior has linked, reviewable evidence.
No unresolved safety, access, gauge, privacy, or data-integrity blocker remains.
An independent verifier confirms the change and its evidence package.
Focused tests, typechecks, route audits, and production build/smoke checks pass.
A bounded rollback or revert path is identified before merge.

requiredBeforeDone: every eligible gauge has a durable disposition
every route-capable gauge is covered or has an accepted blocker
bounded fresh discovery sweep across distinct candidate families
no candidate clears the scored-route evidence, safety, gauge, access, camping, geometry, coordinate, and image gates
saturationPolicy.discoveryBudget: bounded by the active state task; stop after the documented candidate budget or when a strong scored route is found
saturationPolicy.reopenCondition: new eligible gauge, resumed telemetry, cleared blocker, user demand, provider expansion, retired direct coverage, or fresh manager-grade access, threshold, safety, or route-shape evidence
